cmd_install_add_to_path: Shown after the last line of `atlas install` (Unix) when the shell has no ready-made PATH line; {dir} is the install folder.
cmd_install_copied: Result line of `atlas install` after copying the binary; {path} is the installed file.
cmd_install_copy_failed: Cause line of an install error: copying the atlas binary to its temporary file failed. {path} is the temporary file.
cmd_install_create_failed: Cause line of an install or uninstall error: creating a folder failed. {path} is the folder.
cmd_install_done_new_terminal: Windows only: last line of `atlas install`.
cmd_install_done_new_terminal_or_here: Last line of `atlas install` (Unix) when this shell does not see `atlas` yet; the line to run follows.
cmd_install_done_this_shell: Last line of `atlas install` (Unix) when `atlas` is already reachable from this shell.
cmd_install_failed: Result line of `atlas uninstall` for one step that failed, after a red cross; {item} is the description of the item, {reason} the error. Aligned with cmd_install_removed.
cmd_install_get_started: Heading of the three commands that end `atlas install`.
cmd_install_hint_dev: What `atlas dev` does, in the Get started list at the end of `atlas install`; printed after the command in a column.
cmd_install_hint_setup: What `atlas setup` does, in the Get started list at the end of `atlas install`; printed after the command in a column.
cmd_install_hint_update: What `atlas update` does, in the Get started list at the end of `atlas install`; printed after the command in a column.
cmd_install_inspect_failed: Cause line of an `atlas uninstall` step failure: reading the metadata of a path failed.
cmd_install_install_failed: Cause line of an install error: moving the new binary into place failed. {path} is the installed atlas binary.
cmd_install_item_fish_universal: Item of the `atlas uninstall` list: the install folder stored by old installs in fish's universal fish_user_paths.
cmd_install_item_package: Linux only: item of the `atlas uninstall` list: a distro package, removed by the package manager. {name} is the package, {command} the command that removes it.
cmd_install_item_rc_block: Item of the `atlas uninstall` list: a shell startup file where only the PATH block Atlas wrote is removed.
cmd_install_item_shell_file: Item of the `atlas uninstall` list: a fish or nushell startup file that Atlas wrote whole.
cmd_install_item_user_path: Windows only: item of the `atlas uninstall` list: the install folder in the user PATH.
cmd_install_kept_link: Result line of `atlas install` when a dev-build symlink is at the destination and was left alone; {path} is the symlink.
cmd_install_kept_newer: Result line of `atlas install` when a newer CLI is already installed and was left alone; {installed} and {own} are versions without the v.
cmd_install_link_failed: Cause line of an install error: creating the `~/.local/bin/atlas` symlink failed. {path} is the link.
cmd_install_link_taken: Warning of `atlas install` (Unix) when something else is at `~/.local/bin/atlas`.
cmd_install_linked: Result line of `atlas install` (Unix) after linking `~/.local/bin/atlas` to the installed binary.
cmd_install_no_exe: Error of `atlas install` when the operating system does not say where the running executable is.
cmd_install_no_home: Error of `atlas install` and `atlas install --upgrade` when the system has no home folder for this user. Names the variable that holds it: USERPROFILE on Windows, HOME elsewhere.
cmd_install_no_parent: Error of `atlas install` when the destination path has no folder to put the binary in. {path} is the destination file.
cmd_install_no_powershell: Windows only: error of the installer when it cannot start PowerShell to edit the user PATH.
cmd_install_no_startup_file: Warning of `atlas install` (Unix) when bash has none of its login files. The PATH line to put in the file follows on the next line. {shell} is the shell name.
cmd_install_not_ours: Error of `atlas install` (Unix) for one shell: a fish or nushell startup file of the person's own sits under the name Atlas uses. {line} is the PATH line to add.
cmd_install_note_app: Note after a path in the `atlas uninstall` list: the installed desktop app. A product name.
cmd_install_note_app_backup: Note after a path in the `atlas uninstall` list: the copy of the installed app that `atlas link --desktop` set aside.
cmd_install_note_app_linked: Note after a path in the `atlas uninstall` list: the desktop app is a symlink made by `atlas link --desktop`.
cmd_install_note_app_version: Note after a path in the `atlas uninstall` list: a file that records which desktop app version is installed.
cmd_install_note_cli: Note after `~/.atlas/bin` in the `atlas uninstall` list.
cmd_install_note_crash_reports: Linux only: note after a path in the `atlas uninstall --purge` list: the crash reports of the app.
cmd_install_note_desktop_debug_socket: Note after a path in the `atlas uninstall` list: the debug bridge socket of the desktop app.
cmd_install_note_desktop_socket: Note after a path in the `atlas uninstall` list: the socket the desktop app listens on.
cmd_install_note_desktop_token: Note after a path in the `atlas uninstall` list: the token for the desktop control socket.
cmd_install_note_everything: Note after `~/.atlas` in the `atlas uninstall --purge` list: all of it goes.
cmd_install_note_host_log: Note after a path in the `atlas uninstall` list: the hostd log file.
cmd_install_note_host_pid: Note after a path in the `atlas uninstall` list: the hostd pid file.
cmd_install_note_host_socket: Note after a path in the `atlas uninstall` list: the hostd socket file.
cmd_install_note_host_token: Note after a path in the `atlas uninstall` list: the hostd token file.
cmd_install_note_link_on_path: Note after a path in the `atlas uninstall` list: the `~/.local/bin/atlas` symlink.
cmd_install_note_menu_entry: Linux only: note after a path in the `atlas uninstall` list: the launcher entry of the desktop app.
cmd_install_note_menu_icon: Linux only: note after a path in the `atlas uninstall` list: the icon of the launcher entry.
cmd_install_note_prev_app: Linux only: note after a path in the `atlas uninstall` list: the old AppImage an interrupted update left.
cmd_install_note_remote_cache: Note after a path in the `atlas uninstall` list: binaries cached for crew servers.
cmd_install_note_staged_app: Linux only: note after a path in the `atlas uninstall` list: the new AppImage an interrupted update left.
cmd_install_note_update_check: Note after a path in the `atlas uninstall` list: the cached result of the last update check.
cmd_install_note_update_lock: Note after a path in the `atlas uninstall` list: the lock file of `atlas update`.
cmd_install_note_webkit_store: Linux only: note after a path in the `atlas uninstall --purge` list: the WebView data folder of the app.
cmd_install_note_webkit_store_legacy: Linux only: note after a path in the `atlas uninstall --purge` list: the WebView data folder of the app before version 1.6.
cmd_install_note_window_state: Linux only: note after a path in the `atlas uninstall --purge` list: where the app remembers its window size and position.
cmd_install_open_failed: Cause line of an install error: opening a shell startup file to append the PATH block failed. {path} is the file.
cmd_install_path_added: Result line of `atlas install` (Unix), one per shell: the PATH block was written. {shell} is the shell name, {file} its startup file.
cmd_install_path_added_win: Windows only: result line of `atlas install` after adding the install folder to the user PATH.
cmd_install_path_already: Result line of `atlas install` (Unix), one per shell: the startup file already had the PATH block. {shell} is the shell name, {file} its startup file.
cmd_install_path_already_win: Windows only: result line of `atlas install` when the install folder is already on PATH.
cmd_install_path_manual: Windows only: warning of `atlas install` when editing the user PATH failed; {dir} is the install folder, {reason} the system's error.
cmd_install_plan_keep: Heading of the list of things `atlas uninstall` keeps (the person's data); one path per line follows.
cmd_install_plan_remove: Heading of the list of things `atlas uninstall` removes (also `--list`); one item per line follows.
cmd_install_read_failed: Cause line of an `atlas uninstall` step failure: reading a shell startup file failed.
cmd_install_remove_busy: Cause line of an `atlas uninstall` step failure: deleting a file or folder tree failed, usually because something still uses it.
cmd_install_remove_failed: Cause line of an `atlas uninstall` step failure: deleting a file or link failed.
cmd_install_removed: Result line of `atlas uninstall` for one step that worked, after a green check; {item} is the description of the item. Aligned with cmd_install_failed.
cmd_install_shell_unsupported: Warning of `atlas install` (Unix) when the login shell is one Atlas has no PATH line for. {shell} is the shell name, {dir} the install folder.
cmd_install_skills: Progress heading of `atlas install` before it installs the bundled agent skills.
cmd_install_skills_failed: Warning of `atlas install` when installing the bundled skills failed; the install itself went on. {reason} is the error.
cmd_install_sudo_own_home: Same warning as cmd_install_sudo_warning, for the case where the home folder belongs to the person who ran sudo, so the files end up owned by root.
cmd_install_sudo_warning: Warning of `atlas install` (Unix) when it runs under sudo. {home} is the home folder it writes to, {euid} the effective uid, {user} the person who ran sudo.
cmd_install_target: Second detail line of `atlas install`, aligned with the Version line; {dir} is the install folder.
cmd_install_uninstall_aborted: `atlas uninstall` after the person answered no.
cmd_install_uninstall_confirm: Prompt of `atlas uninstall` after the plan, without `--purge`: names the action. The capital letter is the default (no). The accepted yes answers are y, yes, s and sim in every language.
cmd_install_uninstall_confirm_purge: Prompt of `atlas uninstall --purge` after the plan: names the cost, since the whole `~/.atlas` (settings, projects, worktrees) goes. Same answers as cmd_install_uninstall_confirm.
cmd_install_uninstall_done: Last line of `atlas uninstall` when every step worked.
cmd_install_uninstall_needs_confirmation: Error of `atlas uninstall` when stdin is not a terminal and `--yes` was not given.
cmd_install_uninstall_nothing: `atlas uninstall` when it found nothing of Atlas on this machine.
cmd_install_uninstall_steps_failed: Error of `atlas uninstall` when some removal steps failed (the others went through). {count} is how many failed, at least 1.
cmd_install_upgrade_absent: The one line of `atlas install --upgrade` when no CLI is installed yet. {path} is where the CLI would be.
cmd_install_upgrade_current: The one line of `atlas install --upgrade` when the installed CLI is the same or newer. {version} is the installed version.
cmd_install_upgrade_linked: The one line of `atlas install --upgrade` when the installed CLI is a symlink made by `atlas link`. {path} is the symlink.
cmd_install_upgrade_replaced: The one line of `atlas install --upgrade` after replacing the CLI. {old} is the previous version or the unreadable-version marker, {new} the version now installed.
cmd_install_upgrade_self: The one line of `atlas install --upgrade` when it runs from the installed copy itself. {version} is the installed version, or the unreadable-version marker.
cmd_install_version: First detail line of `atlas install`, aligned with the Target line; {version} is this binary's version.
cmd_install_version_unreadable: Stands in for the installed version in the `atlas install --upgrade` line when the installed CLI did not report a version; shown inside a sentence.
cmd_install_write_failed: Cause line of an install or uninstall error: writing a file failed (a shell startup file, a PATH file). {path} is the file.
